messages.text: I received my nexus S1. It says it is supposed to come with a Mean well lrs 350. However the power supply I received is a mean well lrs 200
Read the nexus s1 10th s page
Handed to the team · wrong power supply shipped with Nexus S1; needs correct PSU sent and spec confir

Sorry about that, Nicholas. If the listing says LRS-350 and an LRS-200 came in the box, that's a packing error on us, not something you should have to sort out.

I don't want to guess whether the LRS-200 is safe to run on your S1, so hold off powering it until that's confirmed rather than risk the unit.

I've passed it to the team with your order so the correct supply goes out. They pick this up today at 10am ET and will confirm by email to (email hidden)
